page.description:
- Page number (starts from 1)
- Results per page: 80

description: Get historical property transaction data (sales and rentals) for Dubai/UAE. Filter by purpose, category, location, completion status, time period, bedrooms, price range, and area. Useful for market analysis and pricing trends.

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description:
- Transaction type
- `for-sale`  -  sale transactions
- `for-rent`  -  rental transactions

schema.description:
- Transaction type
- `for-sale`  -  sale transactions
- `for-rent`  -  rental transactions

parameters.name: page
parameters.description:
- Page number (starts from 1)
- Results per page: 20

schema.description:
- Page number (starts from 1)
- Results per page: 20

parameters.name: category_ids
parameters.description:
- Comma-separated category names or external IDs
- Names: `residential`, `commercial`, `apartments`, `villas`, `townhouses`, `penthouse`, `offices`, `shops`, etc.
- Or external IDs: `1` (residential), `2` (commercial), `4` (apartments), `3` (villas)
- Example: `apartments,villas,townhouses` or `4,3,16`

schema.description:
- Comma-separated category names or external IDs
- Names: `residential`, `commercial`, `apartments`, `villas`, `townhouses`, `penthouse`, `offices`, `shops`, etc.
- Or external IDs: `1` (residential), `2` (commercial), `4` (apartments), `3` (villas)
- Example: `apartments,villas,townhouses` or `4,3,16`

parameters.name: location_ids
parameters.description: - Comma-separated location external IDs from `/autocomplete`

schema.description: - Comma-separated location external IDs from `/autocomplete`

parameters.name: completion_status
parameters.description: - Filter by completion status

schema.description: - Filter by completion status

parameters.name: time_period
parameters.description:
- Time period for transaction data
- `1m`  -  last 1 month
- `3m`  -  last 3 months
- `6m`  -  last 6 months
- `12m`  -  last 12 months (default)
- `24m`  -  last 24 months

schema.description:
- Time period for transaction data
- `1m`  -  last 1 month
- `3m`  -  last 3 months
- `6m`  -  last 6 months
- `12m`  -  last 12 months (default)
- `24m`  -  last 24 months

parameters.name: beds
parameters.description:
- Comma-separated bedrooms filter
- `0` = Studio

schema.description:
- Comma-separated bedrooms filter
- `0` = Studio

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: - Minimum price in AED

schema.description: - Minimum price in AED

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: - Maximum price in AED

schema.description: - Maximum price in AED

parameters.name: area_min
parameters.description: - Minimum area in sqft

schema.description: - Minimum area in sqft

parameters.name: area_max
parameters.description: - Maximum area in sqft

schema.description: - Maximum area in sqft

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description:
- Sort order for transactions
- `date_desc`  -  newest first (default)
- `date_asc`  -  oldest first
- `price_desc`  -  highest price first
- `price_asc`  -  lowest price first
- `area_desc`  -  largest area first
- `area_asc`  -  smallest area first

description: Search for property amenities by keyword. Returns amenity names and the count of properties that have each amenity. Use the returned amenity names in the `/search-property` endpoint's `amenities` parameter.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
- Search query for amenities
- Examples: `swimming`, `gym`, `security`, `parking`, `sauna`
- Returns matching amenity names that can be used in `/search-property` `amenities` parameter
